run_check_qps_scenario_changes: run the sanity check script to verify qps benchmark scenario files have not been updated
run_json_run_localhost_scenario_gen: run the json_run_localhost_scenario_gen.py script to regenerate localhost QPS scenario files
run_qps_json_driver_scenario_gen: run the qps_json_driver_scenario_gen.py script to regenerate QPS JSON driver scenario files
run_buildifier_on_qps_dir: run buildifier in verbose recursive mode on the test/cpp/qps directory
check_git_status_for_bzl_changes: check git status to detect uncommitted changes to qps_json_driver_scenarios.bzl or json_run_localhost_scenarios.bzl
